description.value: Caffe Motivo is an independent café in the heart of downtown Kamloops, serving specialty coffee sourced from JJ Bean alongside fresh-baked goods and light breakfasts and lunches made in-house daily. It occupies a street-level location on Victoria Street, making it a convenient stop for cyclists passing through the city centre. The café also offers a catering service, suggesting a kitchen capable of producing larger food orders.
